name: search_dealings
description: List recent insider share dealings in one market, newest first. By default only filings ddbx rated as signal (significant, noteworthy or minor); set signal_only=false for every screened open-market filing. Filter by ticker and by disclosure date.

arguments.name: market
arguments.desc: UK = LSE directors; US = SEC Form 4 insiders; SE = Sweden; NL = Netherlands; USG = members of the US Congress.

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Only filings disclosed on or after this date.

arguments.name: before
arguments.desc: Only filings disclosed before this date (use to page back).

arguments.name: signal_only
arguments.desc: Only filings rated significant, noteworthy or minor (default true); false returns every screened open-market filing

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of filings to return

name: get_dealing
description: One filing by the id returned from search_dealings or get_company (e.g. "UK:…", "US:f4-…").

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: ddbx filing id, as returned by search_dealings

name: get_company
description: Recent insider dealings at one UK- or US-listed company, with a short description of the business and a link to its ddbx company page.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of filings to return (1-50, default 20)

name: get_daily_summary
description: ddbx's written recap of a trading day's insider dealings (UK or US), with the filings it cites. Omit date for the latest.

arguments.name: session
arguments.desc: afternoon is the end-of-day recap; morning covers the opening session.

name: search
description: Find recent insider dealings at a company by name or ticker (UK and US). Returns ids to pass to fetch.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Free-text query, e.g. a company name or ticker

name: fetch
description: The full thin-tier record for one id returned by search.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: ddbx filing id, as returned by search
